  SELECT CASE

) t WHERE bin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.q: 각 구·군에서 가장 높은 건물과 두 번째 높은 건물의 높이 차이를 보여줘
questions.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT CASE LEFT("A3", 5) WHEN '26110' THEN '중구' WHEN '26140' THEN '서구' WHEN '26170' THEN '동구' WHEN '26200' THEN '영도구' WHEN '26230' THEN '부산진구' WHEN '26260' THEN '동래구' WHEN '26290' THEN '남구' WHEN '26320' THEN '북구' WHEN '26350' THEN '해운대구' WHEN '26380' THEN '사하구' WHEN '26410' THEN '금정구' WHEN '26440' THEN '강서구' WHEN '26470' THEN '연제구' WHEN '26500' THEN '수영구' WHEN '26530' THEN '사상구' WHEN '26710' THEN '기장군' ELSE LEFT("A3", 5) END AS gu, NULLIF(TRIM("A16"::text), '')::float8 AS h,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE LEFT("A3", 5) WHEN '26110' THEN '중구' WHEN '26140' THEN '서구' WHEN '26170' THEN '동구' WHEN '26200' THEN '영도구' WHEN '26230' THEN '부산진구' WHEN '26260' THEN '동래구' WHEN '26290' THEN '남구' WHEN '26320' THEN '북구' WHEN '26350' THEN '해운대구' WHEN '26380' THEN '사하구' WHEN '26410' THEN '금정구' WHEN '26440' THEN '강서구' WHEN '26470' THEN '연제구' WHEN '26500' THEN '수영구' WHEN '26530' THEN '사상구' WHEN '26710' THEN '기장군' ELSE LEFT("A3", 5) END ORDER BY NULLIF(TRIM("A16"::text), '')::float8 DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
  FROM "AL_D010_26_20250704" WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("A16"::text), '')::float8 > 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM("A16"::text), '')::float8 <= 500
)
SELECT a.gu, a.h AS h1, b.h AS h2, a.h - b.h AS diff
FROM ranked a JOIN ranked b ON a.gu = b.gu AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST

questions.q: 부산에서 높이 상위 1% 건물의 평균 연면적을 구해줘
questions.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(TRIM("A16"::text), '')::float8 AS h, NULLIF(TRIM("A14"::text), '')::float8 AS gfa FROM "AL_D010_26_20250704" WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("A16"::text), '')::float8 > 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM("A16"::text), '')::float8 <= 500 AND NULLIF(TRIM("A14"::text), '')::float8 IS NOT NULL
), p AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY h) AS cut FROM base)
SELECT AVG(gfa) AS avg_gfa, COUNT(*)::bigint AS n, (SELECT cut FROM p) AS cut
FROM base, p WHERE h >= p.cut

questions.q: 부산에서 연면적 상위 5% 건물의 평균 지상층수를 알려줘
questions.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(TRIM("A14"::text), '')::float8 AS gfa, NULLIF(TRIM("A26"::text), '')::float8 AS fl FROM "AL_D010_26_20250704" WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("A14"::text), '')::float8 > 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM("A26"::text), '')::float8 IS NOT NULL
), p AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gfa) AS cut FROM base)
SELECT AVG(fl) AS avg_fl, COUNT(*)::bigint AS n, (SELECT cut FROM p) AS cut
FROM base, p WHERE gfa >= p.cut

questions.q: 구·군별 건물당 평균 대지면적을 구하고 부산 전체 평균과 비교해줘
questions.sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT CASE LEFT("A3", 5) WHEN '26110' THEN '중구' WHEN '26140' THEN '서구' WHEN '26170' THEN '동구' WHEN '26200' THEN '영도구' WHEN '26230' THEN '부산진구' WHEN '26260' THEN '동래구' WHEN '26290' THEN '남구' WHEN '26320' THEN '북구' WHEN '26350' THEN '해운대구' WHEN '26380' THEN '사하구' WHEN '26410' THEN '금정구' WHEN '26440' THEN '강서구' WHEN '26470' THEN '연제구' WHEN '26500' THEN '수영구' WHEN '26530' THEN '사상구' WHEN '26710' THEN '기장군' ELSE LEFT("A3", 5) END AS gu, AVG(NULLIF(TRIM("A15"::text), '')::float8) AS avg_lot FROM "AL_D010_26_20250704" GROUP BY 1
), city AS (SELECT AVG(NULLIF(TRIM("A15"::text), '')::float8) AS city_avg FROM "AL_D010_26_20250704")

FROM g, city ORDER BY g.avg_lot DESC NULLS LAST

questions.q: 동래구 업무시설 중 높이 상위 20% 건물의 평균 연면적을 알려줘
questions.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(TRIM("A30"::text), '')::float8 AS h, NULLIF(TRIM("A19"::text), '')::float8 AS gfa FROM "AL_D198_26260_20260715" WHERE "A25"='업무시설' AND NULLIF(TRIM("A30"::text), '')::float8 IS NOT NULL
), p AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.80) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY h) AS cut FROM base)
SELECT AVG(gfa) AS avg_gfa, COUNT(*)::bigint AS n FROM base, p WHERE h >= p.cut

금정구에서 준공연대별 건물 수를 1980년대 이전, 1980년대, 1990년대, 2000년대, 2010년대, 2020년대로 나눠 보여줘
questions.sql:
SELECT bin, COUNT(*)::bigint AS n FROM (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN y < 1980 THEN '1980년대 이전'
    WHEN y BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 THEN '1980년대'
    WHEN y BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999 THEN '1990년대'
    WHEN y BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 THEN '2000년대'
    WHEN y BETWEEN 2010 AND 2019 THEN '2010년대'
    WHEN y >= 2020 THEN '2020년대'

questions.q: 동래구에서 허가 후 준공까지 걸린 기간이 가장 긴 건물 10개를 보여줘
금정구에서 허가 후 준공까지 걸린 기간이 가장 짧은 양수 기간 건물 10개를 보여줘
금정구와 동래구에서 30년 이상 건물 비율 차이를 계산해줘
questions.sql:
SELECT
  gj.r AS gj_ratio30, dr.r AS dr_ratio30, gj.r - dr.r AS diff
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "A34" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' AND "A34"::date <= (DATE '2026-08-27' - INTERVAL '30 years'))::float8 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "A34" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),0) AS r
  FROM "AL_D198_26410_20260715"
) gj,
(
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "A34" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' AND "A34"::date <= (DATE '2026-08-27' - INTERVAL '30 years'))::float8 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "A34" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),0) AS r
  FROM "AL_D198_26260_20260715"
) dr
